allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange about allotment of 3900000 fully convertible warrants

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange allotment of equity shares pursuant to conversion of warrants

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on November 04, 2025.Allotment of Equity Shares of the Company pursuant to Exercise of Share Warrants

allot.subject: Disclosure of material issue
allot.text: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has informed regarding Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Allotment of Equity Shares and Fully Convertible Warrants

allot.subject: Disclosure of material issue
allot.text: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue regarding conversion of equity warrants into equity shares

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on March 04, 2025 in regards to disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Conversion of equity warrants into equity shares
